packed_note: values[k] belongs to the k-th hex (in cell order) whose world.json owner is >= 0

lenses.name: Population density
lenses.description: Residents on 1 January 2026 per km² of hex area. Each municipality's official population is spread over its hexes in proportion to the GEOSTAT 1 km population grid (2018).
lenses.note: Estimated using the municipality's total and the 1 km population grid.

lenses.name: Population change 2016–26
lenses.description: Change in resident population between 1 January 2016 and 1 January 2026 on today's municipal borders (Norway: SSB's aggregated series for the 2024 municipalities). A municipality whose territory changed between the two years (split predecessors, transfers recorded in SSB's classification) has no comparable figure. The municipality panel explains why.
lenses.note: 7 municipalities have no comparable 2016 figure (boundary changes) and show no value. Each municipality has one colour.

lenses.name: Aged 65+
lenses.description: Share of residents aged 65 or older, 1 January 2026 (Sweden: 31 December 2025).
lenses.note: Each municipality has one colour.

lenses.name: Aged 0–19
lenses.description: Share of residents aged 0–19, 1 January 2026 (Sweden: 31 December 2025).
lenses.note: Each municipality has one colour.

lenses.name: GDP per person (PPS)
lenses.description: Regional GDP 2023 divided by the region's average population, converted to purchasing power standards (Eurostat PPP, EU27 = 1). Norway: gross value added at basic prices, on the 2020–2023 counties, without the continental shelf; this understates Norway relative to Sweden and Denmark by roughly the size of taxes on products.
lenses.note: Norway shows value added at basic prices (no product taxes) and excludes offshore oil and gas. Each region has one colour.

lenses.name: Jobs per 100 residents
lenses.description: Jobs located in the municipality (place of work, Nov/Q4 2024) per 100 residents. Above ~50 marks a commuting centre that draws workers from its neighbours.
lenses.note: Each municipality has one colour.

lenses.name: Industry jobs
lenses.description: Share of the municipality's jobs (place of work, 2024) in: industry (harmonised NACE group BC).
lenses.note: Small municipalities: Norwegian cells with fewer than a handful of jobs are suppressed (shown as part of 'unknown'). Each municipality has one colour.

lenses.name: Primary sector jobs
lenses.description: Share of the municipality's jobs (place of work, 2024) in: primary sector (harmonised NACE group A).
lenses.note: Small municipalities: Norwegian cells with fewer than a handful of jobs are suppressed (shown as part of 'unknown'). Each municipality has one colour.

lenses.name: ICT jobs
lenses.description: Share of the municipality's jobs (place of work, 2024) in: ict (harmonised NACE group J).
lenses.note: Small municipalities: Norwegian cells with fewer than a handful of jobs are suppressed (shown as part of 'unknown'). Each municipality has one colour.

lenses.name: Tourism & hospitality jobs
lenses.description: Share of the municipality's jobs (place of work, 2024) in: tourism & hospitality (harmonised NACE group I).
lenses.note: Small municipalities: Norwegian cells with fewer than a handful of jobs are suppressed (shown as part of 'unknown'). Each municipality has one colour.

lenses.name: Public administration jobs
lenses.description: Share of the municipality's jobs (place of work, 2024) in: public administration (harmonised NACE group O).
lenses.note: Small municipalities: Norwegian cells with fewer than a handful of jobs are suppressed (shown as part of 'unknown'). Each municipality has one colour.

lenses.name: Specialisation
lenses.description: The industry group with the highest location quotient (share of local jobs ÷ share in Norway, Sweden and Denmark combined) of at least 1.5 with at least 250 jobs; 'Diversified' when none qualifies.
lenses.note: Each municipality has one colour.

lenses.name: Income relative to national reference
lenses.description: Experimental. Municipal income relative to the national figure of the same statistic: Norway median household income after tax (2024), Sweden median net income of residents 20+ (2024), Denmark average disposable income of persons with income (2024). 100% = the country's own national figure. The three statistics measure different things (household vs person, median vs mean), so a colour says where a municipality stands within its own country, not how incomes compare across borders; values are nominal and not adjusted for prices or purchasing power.
lenses.note: Definitions differ between countries: read colours within one country. Each municipality has one colour.

lenses.name: Time to hospital
lenses.description: Average road travel time from where people live to the nearest hospital (Eurostat/GISCO 1 km accessibility grid), weighted by the population of each 1 km cell in the hex.
lenses.note: Hexes with no inhabited 1 km cell have no value. Each hex combines figures from the 1 km grid.

lenses.name: Time to primary school
lenses.description: Average road travel time to the nearest primary school (Eurostat/GISCO), population-weighted.
lenses.note: Each hex combines figures from the 1 km grid.

lenses.name: Reachable population
lenses.description: Population that can be reached within 90 minutes by road (EC road transport performance, 1 km grid), averaged over the hex's inhabitants: a measure of market and labour access.
lenses.note: Each hex combines figures from the 1 km grid.

lenses.name: Distance to a large town
lenses.description: Straight-line distance from the hex centre to the main settlement of the nearest municipality with at least 50,000 residents (2026).
lenses.note: Straight line, not travel time; fjords and mountains make real journeys longer. Each hex combines figures from the 1 km grid.

lenses.name: Elevation
lenses.description: Mean elevation of the hex's 1 km EU-DEM cells.
lenses.note: Each hex combines figures from the 1 km grid.

lenses.name: Tree cover
lenses.description: Mean Copernicus Tree Cover Density (2018) of the hex's 1 km cells.
lenses.note: Each hex combines figures from the 1 km grid.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land in CORINE arable, permanent crop, agricultural mosaic and pasture classes (2018).
lenses.note: Each hex combines figures from the 1 km grid.

lenses.name: Land cover
lenses.description: Dominant CORINE Land Cover 2018 group of the hex (rules in the Almanac).
lenses.note: Each hex combines figures from the 1 km grid.

categories.name: Broadleaf forest
categories.description: Forest is the largest group and broad-leaved (CLC 311) the largest forest type.

categories.name: Conifer forest
categories.description: Forest is the largest group and coniferous (CLC 312) the largest type: the boreal taiga.

categories.name: Mixed forest
categories.description: Forest is the largest group and mixed forest (CLC 313) the largest type.

categories.name: Woodland & scrub
categories.description: Transitional woodland-shrub (CLC 324, often clear-cuts and mountain birch) is the largest group.

categories.name: Grassland
categories.description: Natural grassland (CLC 321) is the largest group.

categories.name: Farmland
categories.description: Arable land, permanent crops and agricultural mosaics (CLC 211-244) are the largest group.

categories.name: Mire & wetland
categories.description: Inland marshes, peat bogs, salt marshes and tidal flats (CLC 411-423) are the largest group.

categories.name: Urban
categories.description: Artificial surfaces (CLC 111-142) are ≥ 30% of the hex's land, whatever else is there.

categories.name: Bare rock
categories.description: Bare rock, sparsely vegetated areas, beaches and burnt areas (CLC 331-334) are the largest group.

categories.name: Glacier
categories.description: Glaciers and perpetual snow (CLC 335) are ≥ 30% of the hex's land.

categories.name: Fjell heath
categories.description: Moors and heathland (CLC 322) are the largest group: the treeless fjell and coastal heath.

lenses.name: New built-up land 1990–2018
lenses.description: Number of 1 km cells in the hex whose CORINE class became artificial (built-up, industrial, mines, transport) between 1990 and 2018.
lenses.note: 1 km cells take one class each, so only substantial change registers. Each hex combines figures from the 1 km grid.

lenses.name: Public shelter places (Norway)
lenses.description: Places in public shelters in each Norwegian municipality, from DSB (2026-11-27). Private shelters are not shown.
lenses.note: Sweden and Denmark: no data. For current shelter access, follow official instructions. Each municipality has one colour.

lenses.name: Forest cover change 1990–2018
lenses.description: Net change in CORINE forest classes: newly classified cells minus cells leaving those classes between 1990 and 2018.
lenses.note: Only cells with a class in both years are compared. Red is loss; green is gain. Zero means no net change, not no changes. A hex is not a municipal boundary.

lenses.name: Agricultural land change 1990–2018
lenses.description: Net change in CORINE agricultural land classes: newly classified cells minus cells leaving those classes between 1990 and 2018.
lenses.note: Only cells with a class in both years are compared. Red is loss; green is gain. Zero means no net change, not no changes. A hex is not a municipal boundary.
